name: The Logic Detective
tip: A good conclusion must be supported by the clues, not just by a guess.

questions.q: All squares are rectangles. A shape is a square. What must be true?
questions.why: If every square is a rectangle, every square has the properties of a rectangle.

questions.q: A bus leaves at 09:20 and arrives at 10:05. How long is the journey?
questions.why: From 09:20 to 10:00 is 40 minutes, then 5 more minutes.
